title.narrative: Code 1_Youths and Gender Engagement for Participation in Governance in Kono District

description.narrative: This concept note focuses on youth and gender engagement in governance in Kono district, highlighting the need for inclusive programmes that empower young people with gender lens, particularly women and girls being aware of the GEWE Act, to address issues like gender-based violence and their rights, access to education, and participation in decision-making, while also promoting youth entrepreneurship and economic opportunities. The majority of youth are eager-the prevailing socio-economic and political difficulties notwithstanding to contribute meaningfully to national development processes, and demonstrate resilience and constructive engagement in their societies. The structural weaknesses in political and economic governance systems and processes across Sierra Leone have until now severely constrained youth leadership and participation in the governance, gender equality and development processes at the community, district and national levels
